action_item_for_main_agent: ALUR E (Dispatch → Trip → Completion with driver check-in/out) was not fully tested due to time constraints. This flow requires: (1) assigning driver + vehicle to a confirmed booking, (2) confirming departure, (3) transitioning through enroute → arrived states, (4) driver login and check-in/out. The Dispatch page is accessible and renders correctly, but the full workflow was not executed. Recommend testing this flow in a future iteration if critical.
